# Own

*Everything you hold, in one picture.*

Bank accounts, wallets, cash, gold, certificates, shares and funds, foreign currency, loans and money held for others, with prices that arrive by themselves.

**Deeper:** Architecture › One main ledger; one linked valuation ledger · Data ownership and derived values. How the pillars fit together: [the map](../README.md).
